name: Lead Capture → CRM Pipeline
description: Automatically capture leads from your portfolio contact form, score them, and add to Notion CRM with smart follow-ups

nodes.name: Webhook - Portfolio Contact Form
nodes.notes: This receives data from your contact form when someone submits. URL: https://your-n8n.com/webhook/portfolio-lead

nodes.name: Score Lead
nodes.notes: Scores leads based on budget, timeline, and service type. Hot leads (70+) get immediate attention.

nodes.name: Add to Notion CRM
nodes.notes: Creates a new page in your Notion CRM database with all lead details

nodes.name: Route by Priority
nodes.notes: Routes leads to different follow-up sequences based on priority

nodes.name: Send HOT Lead Alert

parameters.subject: 🔥 HOT LEAD ALERT: {{$json.name}} - {{$json.budget}}

nodes.notes: Immediately alerts you via email when a hot lead comes in

nodes.name: Start Hot Lead Sequence
nodes.notes: Triggers personalized outreach for hot leads

nodes.name: Start Warm Lead Sequence
nodes.notes: Starts standard follow-up for warm leads

nodes.name: Start Cold Lead Sequence
nodes.notes: Adds to nurture sequence for cold leads

nodes.name: Respond to Website

parameters.responseBody: {"success": true, "message": "Thank you! We'll be in touch soon.", "priority": "{{$json.priority}}"}

nodes.notes: Sends response back to your website
